description: One storyline: its summary, its stories (newest first, paged) and, when it has one, Mappit's AI analysis — the story so far, why it matters, connections and what to watch. Attribute the analysis to Mappit. Pass an id from list_threads, whats_happening or search_mappit.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page of stories, exactly as returned.

detail.description: "brief" (default: the analysis clipped) or "full" (the whole analysis).

id.description: The storyline's id, exactly as returned.

limit.description: Stories per page: default 10, at most 30.

name: get_thread
title: Get a storyline
